# Queries checked against Scryfall's own results (tests/cards-conformance.test.mjs). `## family` starts a group for the
# scores; `# tolerance 0.80: reason` after a query lowers its Jaccard floor from 0.97. Refresh the saved results with
# `node scripts/cards-conformance.mjs --fetch` (600 ms between requests), after `npm run cards:update`.

## colours
c:rg
c>=uw -c:red
id<=esper t:instant
id:c t:land
c=2 is:bear
c:m t:enchantment mv<=2
id=wu
c<=g t:creature mv=1
c:azorius t:creature mv<=2

## types and text
t:merfolk t:legend
t:goblin -t:creature
o:draw t:creature mv<=2
kw:flying -t:creature
fo:"attach to target creature you control"
o:"draw or discard"

## sorting
